name: supabase
tagline_zh: 登录掉线、RLS 静默返回空数组、SSR 里 cookie 和 session 对不上——这些坑它按症状分诊。
tagline_en: Silent empty arrays from RLS, dropped sessions, SSR cookie mismatches: it triages by symptom and points at the.
desc_en: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrati
why_zh: 按症状而不是按产品目录组织，先问你是登录态问题还是数据权限问题，再决定查 getUser。
why_en: Organized by symptom, not by product docs: it first asks whether it's a session problem or a policy problem, then picks getUser.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Supabase 自家栈：Database、Auth、Edge Functions、Realtime。
limit_en: Covers only the Supabase stack (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues, supabase-js/@supabase/ssr); self-hosted.
title_en: Supabase full-stack playbook: RLS, Auth, SSR sessions
